content.title: iRhythm: The Heart Monitor Maker Whose Stock Keeps Beating
content.summary: The market has left medical device stocks in the dust, but heart monitor maker  iRhythm Technologies  is proving an exception.  As doctors and hospitals slap its Zio patch monitors on more patients, the stock has doubled this year.  Worn for a couple of weeks, the Zio monitor looks for irregular heart rhythms, such as atrial fibrillation—a racing heartbeat that can presage a stroke or heart attack.
